thread:
anya: Heads up — onboarding Nimble-13B (converted from Gemma). int8 conversion looks fine performance-wise, but we're seeing token-level drift on long-context QA and summarization. Posting quick diffs and repro. :eyes:

sam: Can you paste the eval numbers and a minimal repro?

anya: Snapshot (summarization / QA / instr-follow):
```
Llama-13B fp16 baseline:    ROUGE-L 37.1 | QA EM 72.3 | Instr 94.3
Nimble-13B int8 (converted): ROUGE-L 34.9 | QA EM 68.0 | Instr 87.8
Delta ~ -2.2 ROUGE-L, -4.3 EM, -6.5 instr
```

anya: Example failing prompt (QA):
"""
Context: <long doc clipped> ... note: the clause on page 7 says x.
Q: According to the doc, what is the threshold for x?
"""
Nimble returns a plausible-but-wrong sentence; Llama returns the exact span.

anya: Repro commands:
```bash
python tools/convert_model.py --src-format gemma --dst-format nimble --in /models/gemma13b/ --out /tmp/nimble13b/ --permute-heads --tok-map ../token_maps/gemma->nimble.json
python infra/eval.py --model /tmp/nimble13b/int8 --tasks summarization,qa --batch 8 --max-len 2048
```

infra-bot: Scheduled: eval job 1761112222-ev completed on cluster-gpu-3 (runtime 22m) ✅

clare: Two quick hypotheses: 1) rotary/freq scaling changed during conversion; 2) token id offset in the tok-map introduced a shifted sentinel.

dave: +1 on token offset. Seen off-by-one in tokenmaps when switching BPE merges. Run a tiny injection test to compare multi-byte punctuation ids.

matt: Also run a KV-cache alignment test: head-order mismatch changes attention patterns on long context. Short->long context consistency test will show it.

anya: Bisect update: if I skip `--permute-heads` the outputs align with baseline. With `--permute-heads` we get drift. Conversion step is suspect.

sam: That suggests headwise rotary mapping vs contiguous proj ordering. When projections are permuted we must remap rotary tables per-head. Try computing rotary freqs per head (headwise) rather than global slicing.

clare: Quick diagnostic — cosine similarity of token embeddings (layer 0) for matched tokens:
```
baseline(fp16) vs nimble(int8 w/permute): 0.997, 0.991, 0.889 (tail)
```
Tail dropping to ~0.89 implies either embedding remap or quantization bias after permutation.

dave: Tokenizer sanity-check: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('vocab.json'); print(t.encode('\u2014').ids)"` — compare across baseline and converted vocab. Also check for id collisions in tok-map.

matt: KV alignment quick script:
```bash
python tests/kv_align.py --model /tmp/nimble13b/int8 --prompt-prefix-file tests/short_prefix.txt --extend 1024
```
Inspect per-head cosine of cached keys across extension; permuted heads will show low correlation traces.

anya: Temporary local fix: after load reorder rotary tables to match projected head ordering and normalize freq scaling: `model.rotary.freq_scale = model.rotary.freq_scale.reshape(heads, -1)[perm]` — crude but it improves metrics by ~+1.2 ROUGE-L. Not ideal.

sam: We should change conversion to emit a `rotary_map.json` when `--permute-heads` is used, mapping head->proj slice. Also add a deterministic token unit test in CI.

clare: Another experiment: keep rotary tables in fp16 while quantizing other weights. If fp16 rotary recovers most of the score, quantization is amplifying the permute error.

anya: I tried that: preserving fp16 rotary recovers most instr-follow (~ now only -1.4 vs baseline). So quantization amplifies the mismatch.

infra-bot: Note: created ticket #INF-4921 and attached conversion logs and eval artifacts.

matt: Action items:
- anya: push conversion change that emits rotary_map + unit test.
- matt: run KV alignment battery on Dedicated and post per-head plots.
- clare: run tokenization map audit and diff for multi-byte tokens.
- sam: schedule quantization sweep (fp16-rotary vs int8-rotary) on the devset.

anya: Opening PR for conversion fix today and will attach minimal repro. Thanks all. :party_parrot:

sam: Once PR lands I'll kick off the quant sweep and run A/B vs Llama baseline on the long-doc QA set.

anya: Will also add "emit rotary_map" to model-onboarding checklist after landing fix; will post reproducer gist.

clare: Raw eval artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-dev/nimble13b/triage/1761112222/ if anyone wants them.

anya: Closing loop — will update when PR merges and infra-run completes.
